caption_L1: This is a line plot named Number of practicing nurses employed in Denmark from 2005 to 2018. Year is drawn using a linear scale from 2006 to 2016 on the x-axis. There is a linear scale from 0 to 60,000 along the y-axis, marked Number of employees.
caption_L2L3: The number of practicing nurses in Denmark was approximately 52,000 in 2005. In 2018 the number was approximately 58,000.  There is an upwards trend , however in 2006 there was a decline and numbers dipped to around 50,000. Between 2012 and 2014 there was no change in numbers.
